mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 30 degrees and overcast near the Military Ridge State Trail under a full moon. Temperatures will dip to an overnight low of 28 degrees with no rain predicted.

Property tax bills will arrive by December 15. Payments can be made in two installments, with the first due January 31. You can pay by mail, online, at the drop boxes at the City Center, or in person at the City Center Administration Office.
Currently, there are no local events scheduled for the next 30 days, but we will keep you posted if that changes.

Regarding the weekly report, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash occurred in a parking lot, resulting in a 34-year-old woman being arrested for O W I with a passenger under 16 years old in the vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Butter Pecan. The store is currently open until 10:00 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
